newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil rallies at close on technical buying.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil rallies at close on technical buying.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS

PALM OIL FUTURES - The market rallied in late trading and closed higher on technical, speculative buying coupled with shortcovering interest after September hit 1,200 ringgit. Expectations of a supportive June 1-25 export data also firmed sentiment. Next Sept resistance is 1,210.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - Also traded higher with interest confined to nearby CPOs and selected oil, on refiners buying.
At the close, the September contract closed 14 ringgit up at 1,202 ringgit ($470.08) a tonne after trading to a high of 1,206.
Double-digit gains were posted across the futures sector.
The firmer sentiment was also supported by speculation of a friendly June 1-25 palm oil export data by cargo surveyor SGS (M) Sdn Bhd on Wednesday.
"Heavier buying was seen in the afternoon. That's the reason why prices were moving up with people estimating a higher export also helping prices," a trader said.
Morning prices were little changed as lack of participation and tight price movements had restricted early activity.
Trading activiy on the futures market picked up in afternoon and turnover was was 2,650 lots traded.
Physicals saw June (south) crude palm oil saw offers at 1,240 ringgit against bids at 1,237.50 after trading from 1,230 to 1,237.50.
June (central) saw offers at 1,225 versus 1,222.50 with earlier trades at 1,215 and 1,222.50.
July (south) was offered at 1,240 against bids of 1,237.50 and July (central) at 1,225 against bids of 1,222.50.
